column1: # The startup and memory benchmark's baselines (ci/bench.py): one row per platform, version and metric. The server part
# measures them in its server-fapi run (ci/runs.tsv: the test mods with the official Fabric API jar), and a metric more
# than 10% over its baseline fails the part (ci.yml). A change that moves one records the new value here, with why:
# that row is how its pull request explains it, and a pull request that changes a baseline must change its why too.
# The metrics, in MB, held within 1% (the allocations) and 2% (the heap) over three to seven local runs of a version,
# where discovery's wall time, which is only reported, varied by up to 18% on a quiet machine, and GitHub's runners
# differ by up to a third:
#   discovery-alloc         what the JVM's threads allocated during Fabricated's discovery (its log line) in the run's
#                           first launch, which translates every Fabric mod
#   discovery-alloc-cached  the same in its second launch, every translation from the cache (SMOKE_WARM_LAUNCH)
#   heap                    the live heap once the server started, after a full GC (SMOKE_BENCH)
# baseline: - for one not recorded yet, which is only reported. why: what set it last.
